readerEvidence.summary: Fresh Astra visual reading of all seven original pages including inline official answers and four converted additional-material pages. Fifteen independent numbered problems, printed lettered subquestions kept within their problems. Source errors preserved: p4 incorrect figure cross-references and contradictory numerical distance calculation; p6 19.05/19.15; p7 barycentric wording; p9 declination 18°05′/18°07′; p11 5.14° (5°18′), 79.8°; p15 unfinished question (c), only relativistic percentages supplied. Constants retain printed Boltzmann unit J K^-2. LongQuestions canonical edition is distinct. Typesetting revision: arcminutes/arcseconds rendered with LaTeX primes; printed Greek disjunction ή rendered with accented eta. No figure pixels changed.
sourceGaps: Question 15(c) ends after the three approaches in the printed source; the missing predicate was not invented.
